hints.title: Rearrangement Inequality
hints.text: The sum of products is minimized when the largest elements of one array are paired with the smallest of the other.

hints.title: Opposite Sorting Strategy
hints.text: Sort the first array in non-decreasing order and the second array in non-increasing order.

hints.title: Pairwise Summation
hints.text: Multiply corresponding elements and accumulate their sum.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all n! permutations is factorial and impractical.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting both arrays allows an optimal linear pairing pass in O(n log n) total time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies the rearrangement inequality directly via sorting.
